items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: that scene is just so beautifully manifested and portrayed in the movie “Pleasantville” when Jeff Daniels plays this soda jerk

ctx.x: Yeah, how many people are going to come and see this person?

Oh and speaking of juke boxes I must say another revelatory moment for me is I was on the road going to a concert with Dad in New Jersey and we went to a typical shiny silver © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

Jersey diner. And then we sat down in the booth and it had one of those juke boxes, you know, where you have pages to flip. And I remember seeing there were Beatle songs and then I saw “Take Five” Dave Brubeck Quartet. Holy God, my dad’s made it. He’s in a juke box along with the Beach Boys and the Beatles and the Rolling Stones. You know. And by the way that scene is just so beautifully manifested and portrayed in the movie “Pleasantville” when Jeff Daniels plays this soda jerk and it’s a movie that’s all,…
